races.name: Burrowkin
races.desc: Stocky diggers who fix things by instinct and learn quickly.

races.name: Flitter
races.desc: Tiny, fast and very nervous. Great for running errands across the ship.

augments.name: Ship's Mascot
augments.desc: Morale is everything: crew hit 8% harder and heal a little anywhere.

events.text: A zoo transport has lost its cargo. Strange creatures float about in bubbles, and the keeper is frantic.

effect.text: It takes hours. The keeper pays you, and one very attached creature refuses to leave.

success.text: Inside is a Flitter, who is delighted to be free and joins your crew.

fail.text: Inside is something with a lot of teeth. It chews through a console before you get it out.

effect.text: The keeper shouts something rude as you jump.

events.text: A small moon riddled with burrows. Burrowkin pop their heads out to stare at your ship.

effect.text: They trade you good parts for shiny things.

choices.text: Ask if anyone wants to see the stars.

effect.text: A young Burrowkin packs a bag and climbs aboard.

events.text: A lost star-whale calf has latched onto your hull and is making sad noises.

effect.text: It takes a jump's worth of fuel, but the reunion is worth it. The mother leaves a gift.

events.text: A floating pet shop sells "low-maintenance space companions". The sign is mostly crossed out.

effect.text: It immediately becomes the most important member of the crew.
